english: Being <arc Amplified /> grants 7% decreased Handling Animation Duration and 7% decreased Reload Animation Duration to Fusion Rifles, Linear Fusion Rifles, and Heat Weapons.

source.text:
2 Piece | Ionic Overclock

While Amplified:
(Linear) Fusion Rifles and Heat Weapons are granted 0.93x Handling Duration Multiplier and 0.93x Reload Duration Multiplier.
